question:
In the following figure series, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1599f5fdf06b9acaa27f93d2c7f3757e080a33212c23281054bc8eb38fcc9ff.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: One crescent flips its orientation (Up ↔ Down) in each consecutive step, following a specific sequence across the $3 \times 3$ grid.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/790b9da95907796216f6e86af470dac0d20d6d64f38b34a5e821db501e650085.png] 

So far, the flips have occurred at top-left, bottom-left, and bottom-right positions.

The next figure will flip the **top-right** crescent while keeping the rest unchanged.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
